description: BC case entity sets per company (purchase/sales documents, lines, items, vendors, customers): record counts, and that every allowlisted $select/filter field exists in the live schema.
notes: purchaseReceipts.orderNumber (filter and $select, added for bc.purchase_reader) is unproven live: the only evidence is Portal outbox-drain.ts@66d7e8b:1196. If BC API v2.0 purchaseReceipts lacks it, select_allowlist_absent and filter_fields_absent for purchaseReceipts turn non-empty and this check fails; that is a real finding (drop the field from live_source_grammar.BC_QUERY_SPECS), not a flake. Every failed read is one case_entity_errors row (company index, the entity set that failed, header or lines, error class, HTTP status, error-code class from integrations.live_source_guard.ERROR_CODE_TOKENS and the fixed detail token); the json_absent assertions still fail the check on any error. Diagnosis fields are injected-transport tested (integrations/tests/test_bc_read_entities.py CaseEntityProbeTests); live-unverified until the live check records a result. Cause of the failures of 2026-10-08 11:31Z and 2026-10-10 18:17Z and 21:12Z: one read each, a different set and company every time (company 0 purchaseOrders, company 0 salesOrderLines, company 2 purchaseReceipts), each SourceUnavailable retried.urlerror with no HTTP status: a connect failure that outlasted the GET's three attempts within seconds (docs/decisions/2026-10-08-bc-three-way-connect-timeout.md), not a refusal. The probe now sends such a GET again after 5 s and 15 s (bc_read.ProbeBackoff, its one retry layer: at most 3 GETs per read, 60 s of pause per probe, a Retry-After over 15 s not retried, no read or repeat that could end past its 240 s wall cap, a read cut there failing with detail wall_cap) before it counts; unit_retries records the repeats. A failure that persists is still an error and still fails this check; the expectations are unchanged.
